card.name: Timing words in 'until', 'in time', 'no later'
card.fires_on: The timing word that completes a time-limit phrase, such as 'until', 'in time', 'no earlier/later than' or 'right now'. It sits right after a verb phrase, 'in', or 'no'.

modes.label: until after an activity
modes.description: 'until' following an instruction about doing or not doing something.
modes.example: Advise patients not to drive or operate machinery<< until>> they have gained sufficient experience on phenter

modes.label: no earlier/later than
modes.description: 'earlier' or 'later' after 'no', setting a time limit.
modes.example: Discard the container no<< later>> than 4 hours after initial closure punct

modes.label: in time / right now
modes.description: 'time' after 'in' or 'just in', or 'now' after 'right', in general prose.
modes.example: supposedly just in<< time>> for a papal conclave ongoing at
